cues.en: In response to what its sponsors claim is an idea whose time has come, the first all drug Olympics opened today in Bogota, Colombia.
cues.zh: 为回应赞助方所称的“时机已到”的理念，首届全药物奥运会今天在哥伦比亚波哥大开幕。

cues.en: Athletes are allowed to take any substance whatsoever before, after, and even during the competition. So far, 115 world records have been shattered. We go now to correspondent Kevin Nealon live in Bogota for the weightlifting finals. Kevin.
cues.zh: 运动员可以在赛前、赛后、甚至比赛中服用任何物质。到目前为止，已有115项世界纪录被打破。现在我们连线驻波哥大的记者Kevin Nealon，举重决赛现场。Kevin。

cues.zh: 奈奎尔、达尔丰，还有某种鱼类麻醉剂。

cues.en: Also, I believe he's had several cocktails within the last hour or so. All of this, of course, is perfectly legal at the All Drug Olympics. In fact, it's encouraged.
cues.zh: 另外，我觉得他在过去一个小时左右喝了好几杯鸡尾酒。当然，这在全药物奥运会上完全合法。事实上，组委会还鼓励这么做。
